title: Gene Modeling and Prediction Protocol
author: Hansheng Zhao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rf7d3rn

steps.title: Annotate assembly with AUGUSTUS
steps.instruction: Run AUGUSTUS version 3.3 with default parameters on the repeat‑masked assembly using Linux CentOS 6.

steps.title: Homology prediction with TBLASTN
steps.instruction: Download protein sequences of the seven reference species (Elaeis guineensis, Phoenix dactylifera, Brachypodium distachyon, Oryza sativa, Setaria italic, Sorghum bicolor, Zea mays) from the Ensembl database, align them to the C. simplicifolius and D. jenkinsiana assemblies with TBLASTN version 2.2.26 (E‑value cutoff 1e‑5) on Linux CentOS 6, then generate splicing patterns using GeneWise version 2.0 on the same system.

substeps.instruction: Download protein FASTA files for the seven species from Ensembl.
Run TBLASTN v2.2.26 against each assembly (C. simplicifolius and D. jenkinsiana) with –evalue 1e-5.
Process TBLASTN hits with GeneWise v2.0 to predict gene structures.

steps.title: RNA‑Seq alignment and assembly
steps.instruction: Identify exon‑intron junctions and refine RNA‑Seq read alignment to the genome with HISAT2 version 2.0.2 on Linux CentOS 6, then define protein‑coding gene models using Cufflinks version 2.2.1 on the same platform.

substeps.instruction: Align RNA‑Seq reads to the genome using HISAT2 v2.0.2.
Assemble aligned reads into transcripts and infer gene models with Cufflinks v2.2.1.

steps.title: Integrate predictions with MAKER
steps.instruction: Combine the ab‑initio (AUGUSTUS), homology‑based (TBLASTN/GeneWise), and RNA‑Seq (HISAT2/Cufflinks) evidence using MAKER version 2 on Linux CentOS 6 to generate the final set of gene models.
